body.statement: After one constant column is separated in every row-stochastic block, let the remaining \(u-1\) contrast columns range independently in \(\overline V_y\). The maximum rank of their images in \(\overline E_S/\overline N_S\) is \(|\mathcal D_S|-\eta(S)\). The maximizing contrast array lies in a nonempty Zariski-open set and has a rational representative; sufficiently small rational perturbation of the uniform row-stochastic blocks realizes it with strictly positive entries.
body.justification: This is the early kill test and the mathematical hinge converting local structural zeros into an exact global rank loss.
body.gap: Rado characterizes independent representatives from prescribed subspaces, while the fortified problem requires simultaneous subspace choices, repeated latent contrasts, a block-constant quotient, and rational positive realization.
body.consumer: The theorem supplies the missing attainment step needed by every support-specific completeness diagnostic in the proposal.
